assessment_policy: Separate validity, contribution, priority and fertility. The executed contribution is a constructive, physical-interface-aware equivalence/compiler instrument with exact witnesses and useful counterexamples; classical algebra is an enabling tool, not a reason to dismiss innovation.

branch_additions.title: Context-closed generative semantics and admissible operator quotients
branch_additions.hypothesis: Generating only independent continuation tests can expose the effective structure without enumerating all paths; declared observation/command changes can be audited as extensions of the response space.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: The raw state or path count grows but traces suggest repeated task responses, or a supervisor gains a new sensor/intervention that may invalidate its macro-interface.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Freeze physical kernels, readable inputs, tasks and resource guards; construct the least invariant continuation space with witness words; separately check stochastic lumpability and physical code realizability.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: Exact Q_a B=B C_a certificates; independent small-word oracle; demonstrated reduction and explicit no-collapse/interface-change falsifiers; no hidden information supplied to the runtime controller.
branch_additions.contribution: Executed constructive adaptation: unchanged 80-state plant gives rank 20 with four commands and rank 4 with HOLD; 81 and five candidate evaluations, exact certificates and explicit observation/quotient adversaries. A factorized family grows 2 to 128 states while retaining rank two.

branch_updates.evidence: A physically correct continuation space and shortest witnesses can now be generated instead of enumerating all paths.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Realize an approximate continuation signature in one of two genuinely noisy update libraries; no free real-valued evaluator coordinate.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: The exact span is full-dimensional or its basis cannot be read/maintained by the controller.
branch_updates.minimal_test: Same finite task and budget; exact encoder/update/decoder witness versus a tolerance and a forbidden-interface example.

branch_updates.evidence: Equal actions and signatures do not confer a physically realizable shared selector. New authority can invalidate a quotient.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Price the whole observation/update/action implementation and certify the smallest upgrade that preserves the expanded continuation space.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: A signature or truth-table composition requires hidden health, an unpriced persistent seed or independently chosen physical rows.
branch_updates.minimal_test: One shared read/write mechanism with two coupled program libraries; cost frontier and separating history.

rejected_additions.claim: Equality of current scores and every isolated command guarantees equality under compositions.
rejected_additions.reason: The four-state PREPARE/CHECK witness has identical single-command survival from x/y, but the two-command word separates them. Reversing order changes the result.

rejected_additions.claim: An open-loop equivalence certificate automatically remains valid after adding readable feedback.
rejected_additions.reason: Two initial laws have identical fixed-action sequence survival but differ 1 versus 1/2 under u=Z. Observation masks raise the response-space dimension from 2 to 4.

rejected_additions.claim: Grouping states with equal linear continuation signatures always defines a stochastic macro-transition kernel.
rejected_additions.reason: A five-state counterexample merges x/y under all survival continuations but their transition masses to signature classes differ. Linear realization succeeds; Markov lumping fails.

rejected_additions.claim: A low semantic rank is a low physical bit budget and removes general search complexity.
rejected_additions.reason: Rank two can distinguish 17 pure states. A delayed-failure N-chain has full rank N. Explicit model construction, numerical precision, policy constraints and optimization complexity remain separate costs.
